description: Affine key projection on secp256k1. Post ONE face, receive the other. Post A (the private face, decimal or 64-hex; k is accepted as the same face) and the court projects Q = A*G and returns it - scalar multiplication, total, no search, closes for every A in [1, n-1]. Post BOTH A and q_hex and the same projection verifies the bond. Post q_hex ALONE and the other face is the discrete log: the court answers verdict CHI_EXHAUSTED with energy_num = n, the bond dimension this instance requires at the current probe (~1.16e77), over energy_den = 4096, the ceiling. That is a COST report, not a claim of impossibility and not a graded pair - the detail names the probe as the limit (an n-squared enumeration that closes to n=17), and the wire status reads MISS today. x(Q) is reported as ground because it is real and derivable, and it is PUBLIC, never a private face. The court never backfills the face it was asked for. Decimal or hex strings; empty means not posted. Floats refused.

A.description: the private face: a secp256k1 scalar as decimal or 64-hex, e.g. 2; the court projects Q = A*G

Q.description: same face as q_hex, old label. e.g. 0479be667ef9dcbbac55a06295ce870b07029bfcdb2dce28d959f2815b16f81798483ada7726a3c4655da4fbfc0e1108a8fd17b448a68554199c47d08ffb10d4b8

k.description: same face as A, old label. e.g. 1

q_hex.description: the public face: uncompressed 04-prefixed secp256k1 point, 130 hex characters; the court projects its shear and period, never a scalar. e.g. 0479be667ef9dcbbac55a06295ce870b07029bfcdb2dce28d959f2815b16f81798483ada7726a3c4655da4fbfc0e1108a8fd17b448a68554199c47d08ffb10d4b8
